title: Request replay and request-id conflict
summary: Recover a message with an unrecognized specimen code, then observe what happens when the same request is submitted again, when its request id is reused by another analyst, and when a new request follows.

steps.note: Create a new, empty synthetic exercise database. init refuses a path that already exists.
Register synthetic patient SYN-EX05-01, AML/MDS FISH order ACC-EX05-0001, and an accessioned bone-marrow specimen.
Ingest the instrument result for ACC-EX05-0001; the message does not file.
